guidelines.title: GPL compatibility
guidelines.source_locations: Main plugin header; readme.txt; assets/fonts/*-LICENSE.txt; dependency and artwork inventory
guidelines.assessment: GPL header and font notices exist; all bundled code, logos and dependencies require provenance/license confirmation.

guidelines.title: Developer responsibility
guidelines.source_locations: All three repositories; security documentation; ownership and reviewer account
guidelines.assessment: Maintainer must confirm rights, accountability, support and contact details.

guidelines.title: Stable version
guidelines.source_locations: package.json; main plugin header; Git tags; Center deployment
guidelines.assessment: 1.2.0 is the existing release; 1.3.0 remains gated. Test stable build.

guidelines.title: Human-readable source
guidelines.source_locations: assets/admin.tailwind.css; assets/admin.ui.css; package.json and build scripts
guidelines.assessment: Provide accessible corresponding source and reproducible build instructions; verify source availability to reviewers.

guidelines.title: No trialware
guidelines.source_locations: Center quota policy; connector local behavior
guidelines.assessment: Free cloud operations and genuine SaaS subscriptions; verify no local code locks or artificial service checks.

guidelines.title: Serviceware
guidelines.source_locations: OAuth, Center job queue, site ownership, quotas, cloud audit
guidelines.assessment: Document substantive externally hosted services, terms and privacy; validate service function and endpoint ownership.

guidelines.title: Consent to contact external services
guidelines.source_locations: Quick Connect; Cron scheduling; readme.txt; approval flow
guidelines.assessment: Pairing initiator binding and explicit consent; verify fresh install has no unsolicited calls, and document all outbound data.

guidelines.title: Executable code
guidelines.source_locations: Connector bootstrap and operation dispatcher; Center job allowlist; MCP registry
guidelines.assessment: Removed arbitrary execution and executable ZIP routes. Review remaining HTML/CSS and installed-plugin activation boundaries; no exception claimed.

guidelines.title: Legal, honest and appropriate conduct
guidelines.source_locations: readme and marketplace claims; operation schemas
guidelines.assessment: No universal compatibility, invented endorsements or malicious execution; review trademarks, legal rights and actual claims.

guidelines.title: No unwanted public-facing links
guidelines.assessment: Verify no inserted credits or promotional links without user consent.

guidelines.title: No dashboard hijacking
guidelines.assessment: Check scoped CSS, navigation, dismissibility, accessibility and admin-only notices on real installations.

guidelines.title: Non-spam public directory pages
guidelines.assessment: Review exact directory listing, contributor identity, non-spam text and accurate external links.

guidelines.title: Use WordPress default libraries
guidelines.source_locations: Admin UI scripts; package.json; enqueued assets
guidelines.assessment: Audit bundled libraries and ensure core-provided alternatives are used where required.

guidelines.title: Reasonable commit frequency
guidelines.assessment: Use controlled SVN release updates after approval, not every Git commit.

guidelines.title: Increment releases
guidelines.source_locations: Git tags, package.json, WordPress header, Stable tag, protocol
guidelines.assessment: Coordinate exact release versions and upgrade/migration tests.

guidelines.title: Complete submission
guidelines.assessment: No submission until stable working package, full required functionality, clean Plugin Check, PHPCS and test evidence.

guidelines.title: Respect trademarks and names
guidelines.source_locations: WordRava branding; marketplace descriptions; third-party plugin references
guidelines.assessment: Confirm author/brand rights, slug availability, no implied endorsement and appropriate third-party naming.

guidelines.title: Directory review discretion
guidelines.source_locations: Review request; acceptance records; release gate
guidelines.assessment: Obtain required reviewer clarification and follow review decisions; no automatic approval assertion.

release_checks.title: Official Plugin Check output for actual release ZIP
WordPress Coding Standards and PHPCompatibility findings resolved
Disposable WordPress real auth, data, SSRF, approval, replay, permissions and cross-site tests
All original plus supplemental adapters and theme requirements verified on actual versions
GPL-compatible package, public corresponding source, font/artwork rights and dependency inventory
Owner-approved terms, privacy, retention/deletion and monitored contact; external service disclosure
All three CI builds and end-to-end staging, migration, rollback and health checks
Validated readme, slug/name, version, ZIP size, checksum and reviewer installation instructions
Record reviewer response for any remaining ambiguous capability or documented complete exclusion

notes: Initial source audit and acceptance plan, not completed compliance. All evidence must be verified by a maintainer against the final artifact. Do not mark requirements passed on mocked or static results alone.
